uru.name: Home

then.say: {PLAYER}! You look exhausted. Sit, sit. I made masala dosa.
then.speaker: Amma

then.say: There! You and {STARTER} are full of energy again. Come home whenever you're tired.
then.speaker: Amma

say: Good morning, sleepyhead! Professor Sharada stopped by.
She wants you at her lab today - something about Urumon! Don't keep her waiting.
else.speaker: Amma

say: {PLAYER}! Finally awake? Professor Sharada came looking for you.
Sudeep already ran to the lab an hour ago. Go on, it's just down the road!
script.speaker: Amma

script.say: A news channel: 'Lakes across the city are foaming again. Experts are baffled.'
A small brass lamp flickers in the pooja shelf.

respawnText: Amma fed your Urumon hot ragi mudde and they are full of energy again. "Be careful out there, kanna."
